title: Roblox Cry
blurb: The default Roblox crying sound: a small, tinny, oddly heartbreaking sob that has soundtracked a million staged blocky tragedies. Roblox roleplay servers effectively run on this clip, which squeezes the entire emotional range of a genre into two seconds of compressed audio. Deployed ironically it becomes devastating, and irony is very nearly the only way anybody deploys it. Play it over minor inconveniences, dropped chips and losses of absolutely no consequence whatsoever. A generation learned what sadness sounds like from a rectangle.
origin: The stock crying emote sound used across Roblox games.
